end.parentNote: Anika practised ways everyone can help keep the school clean, including using bins and keeping water points clear. They identified banana peels as wet waste for the green bin and discussed air and microbes in composting. Anika continued to mix up plastic and foil with compostable waste at the end; this was not corrected after the last example. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet waste, dry waste, and non-compostable waste, explaining why each belongs there.
